slides.stem: Three numbers are in the ratio $2:3:5$. If their sum is $60$, what is the largest of the three numbers?

slides.intro: Count the parts before splitting the total.
slides.trapWhy: $25$ splits $60$ without counting parts first. Every ratio question starts with the part count.

slides.title: Total the parts, then scale
slides.body:
A ratio describes parts of a whole. Add the terms for the part count, divide the total for one part's size, then scale whichever term the question wants.

Three steps, no algebra, works every time.
